metadata.description: Playbooks published by PlaybookRun: skills and MCP servers per task.

plugins.name: dotnet-api-aspire
plugins.description: Official .NET and Aspire skills: Web API, EF Core, tests, AppHost wiring, orchestration, monitoring and deployment.

plugins.name: blazor-web-apps
plugins.description: Official .NET skills for Blazor: create a project, author components, forms, auth, data, prerendering and JS interop.

plugins.name: dotnet-testing
plugins.description: Official .NET skills to run, write and improve tests: filters, MSTest, coverage, gap analysis, test smells and testability.

plugins.name: dotnet-test-migration
plugins.description: Official skills to move test projects: MSTest v1/v2 to v3 to v4, NUnit or xUnit to MSTest, xUnit v3, VSTest to Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

plugins.name: dotnet-upgrade
plugins.description: Official skills to move .NET 8 to 9 to 10 to 11, adopt nullable references, check AOT compatibility and handle breaking changes.

plugins.name: msbuild-build-performance
plugins.description: Official MSBuild skills with the binlog MCP server: diagnose failures, speed up builds, fix incremental builds and clean up project files.

plugins.name: dotnet-performance-diagnostics
plugins.description: Official skills to measure and investigate: BenchmarkDotNet, dotnet-trace, dumps, performance analysis and crash symbolication.

plugins.name: dotnet-maui
plugins.description: Official .NET MAUI skills: environment doctor, Shell navigation, data binding, CollectionView, DI, theming, safe areas and lifecycle.

plugins.name: dotnet-templates-nuget
plugins.description: Official skills for dotnet new templates (find, use, author, validate) and NuGet: central package management and trusted publishing.

plugins.name: modern-csharp
plugins.description: Official C# skills: expert guidance, safe refactoring, C# scripts, P/Invoke, SIMD vectorization and the new .NET 11 APIs.

plugins.name: dotnet-ai-apps
plugins.description: Pick the right .NET AI stack (Microsoft.Extensions.AI, Agent Framework, MCP, RAG) with the official skill and current Learn docs.

plugins.name: windows-forms
plugins.description: The official Windows Forms skill: project setup, designer-friendly code, data binding, high DPI, accessibility and async UI on modern .NET.

plugins.name: azure-for-dotnet
plugins.description: Official Azure skills with the Azure MCP server: prepare, validate and deploy an app, instrument it with App Insights and diagnose it.

plugins.name: angular-apps
plugins.description: The Angular team's official skills and CLI MCP server: new apps with current defaults, signals, forms, routing, SSR, testing and CLI.

plugins.name: react-apps
plugins.description: Vercel's official React skills: performance rules, component composition and view transitions, with shadcn/ui components and Chrome DevTools.

plugins.name: nextjs-on-vercel
plugins.description: Build Next.js apps with Vercel's React rules and the Next.js DevTools MCP server, then inspect and optimize them on Vercel with the Vercel MCP server.

plugins.name: react-router-apps
plugins.description: The React Router team's official skills for framework mode, data mode and declarative mode routing.

plugins.name: svelte-apps
plugins.description: The Svelte team's official skills and MCP server: Svelte 5 runes, best practices and an autofixer for generated components.

plugins.name: react-native-apps
plugins.description: Vercel's official React Native skill: performance, lists, animations, navigation and native modules in React Native and Expo apps.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's frontend-design skill with Vercel's web interface guidelines, Figma's MCP server for designs and Chrome DevTools for review.

plugins.name: web-ui-testing
plugins.description: Anthropic's webapp-testing skill with Playwright and Chrome DevTools MCP servers: drive the app, check behaviour, capture screenshots and logs.

plugins.name: spring-boot-java
plugins.description: Build, test, secure and observe Spring Boot 3 and 4 services, migrate 3.x to 4 and scaffold new projects, with Context7 for current Spring docs.

plugins.name: java-jvm-toolkit
plugins.description: Modern Java day to day, JDK upgrades from 11 to 25, javax to jakarta, JVM diagnostics and debugging, plus Gradle's official build audit and wrapper upgrade.

plugins.name: quarkus
plugins.description: Create, test and ship Quarkus apps with Dev Services, native images and containers, migrate Spring Boot to Quarkus and keep versions current, with the official Quarkus agent MCP.

plugins.name: android-kotlin
plugins.description: Google's official Android skills (Compose performance, XML to Compose, adaptive UI, Navigation 3, edge-to-edge, testing, AGP 9, ANRs, intent security) plus JetBrains' Kotlin skills.

plugins.name: go-modern
plugins.description: Idiomatic Go for your Go version: JetBrains' modern Go guidelines plus skills for errors, concurrency, context, testing, security, linting and naming, with the gopls MCP server.

plugins.name: rust-idiomatic
plugins.description: Idiomatic, safe and fast Rust: Apollo's Rust best-practices handbook and a 265-rule guide to ownership, errors, async, unsafe, API design and performance.

plugins.name: node-typescript-backend
plugins.description: Modern Node.js 22+ with native TypeScript, Fastify APIs, strict types and ESLint 9 flat config from Matteo Collina (Node.js TSC, Fastify lead), plus Hono's official skill.

plugins.name: vue
plugins.description: Vue 3 with the Composition API, `<script setup>` and TypeScript, Vue Router 4, Pinia stores, Vitest and Vue Test Utils tests, and debugging guides for hydration and runtime errors.

plugins.name: nuxt
plugins.description: Nuxt 4 apps (SSR, data fetching, server routes, Nitro deploy presets) and Nuxt UI v4 components, with the official Nuxt and Nuxt UI documentation MCP servers.

plugins.name: deno
plugins.description: The Deno team's skills: project config, npm and JSR dependencies, permissions, Fresh 2 frontends and moving Node or Bun projects to Deno.

plugins.name: python-fastapi
plugins.description: Astral's official uv, Ruff and ty skills, FastAPI's own skill shipped in the FastAPI repository and Pydantic's official skill.

plugins.name: python-notebooks
plugins.description: Create and edit clean Jupyter notebooks, write marimo reactive notebooks or convert Jupyter ones to marimo, and work in a running Jupyter server through the Jupyter MCP server.

plugins.name: flutter-dart
plugins.description: The Flutter and Dart teams' skills for architecture, responsive layout, layout errors, widget and integration tests, routing, JSON, localization and static analysis, with the Dart MCP server.

plugins.name: swift-ios
plugins.description: Paul Hudson's SwiftUI, SwiftData, Swift Testing and Swift Concurrency skills, plus MobileBuildMCP to build, run, test and debug on simulators.

plugins.name: postgres-best-practices
plugins.description: Schema design, indexing, query tuning, zero-downtime migrations, schema exploration and pgvector search for any PostgreSQL database, from Supabase and Tiger Data.

plugins.name: timescaledb
plugins.description: Tiger Data's skills for time-series Postgres: find tables that should be hypertables, set them up, migrate existing tables and query with hyperfunctions.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Build on Supabase (database, auth, RLS, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, CLI) with Supabase's own skills and the Supabase MCP server in read-only mode.

plugins.name: mongodb
plugins.description: MongoDB's official skills for schema design, query and index tuning, connection pools and read-only natural-language queries, with the MongoDB MCP server in read-only mode.

plugins.name: redis
plugins.description: Redis's official skills for data modelling, connections and pipelining, Redis Search and vectors, clustering, security and observability, with the Redis MCP server.

plugins.name: mysql-planetscale
plugins.description: PlanetScale's skills for MySQL schema design, indexing and query tuning, and for Vitess sharding, keyspaces and online schema changes.

plugins.name: prisma-orm
plugins.description: Prisma's official skills: set up Prisma ORM 6, 7 and 8 for any provider, the Client API, the CLI and the upgrade from v6 to v7.

plugins.name: clickhouse
plugins.description: ClickHouse's official skills: review schemas, queries and settings against 31 rules and choose ingestion and modelling patterns, with the ClickHouse MCP server, read-only by default.

plugins.name: elasticsearch
plugins.description: Elastic's official skills for ES|QL, mapping and index design, slow-query profiling, relevance tuning and read-only cluster health checks.

plugins.name: dbt-analytics-engineering
plugins.description: dbt Labs' official skills: build and test dbt models, add unit tests, define Semantic Layer metrics and run dbt commands the right way, with the dbt MCP server.

plugins.name: terraform-iac
plugins.description: HashiCorp's official skills to write, test and refactor Terraform in HashiCorp style, with live provider and module docs from the Terraform MCP server.

plugins.name: pulumi-iac
plugins.description: Pulumi's official skills: best practices, debugging failed `pulumi up` and preview runs, Pulumi ESC secrets and config, and migrating Terraform to Pulumi.

plugins.name: docker-containers
plugins.description: Docker's official skills to containerize a project, write lean multi-stage Dockerfiles and Compose stacks, and confirm before any destructive Docker command, with the Docker docs MCP.

plugins.name: github-ci-and-code-review
plugins.description: Fix failing GitHub Actions checks, work through PR review comments, cut CI minutes, review branches for bugs and write conventional commits, with the read-only GitHub MCP server.

plugins.name: appsec-review
plugins.description: Secure-by-default code review, threat models grounded in your repository, GitHub Actions hardening and checks for secrets leaking through logs and serialization, with GitHub code-scanning alerts.

plugins.name: sentry-error-monitoring
plugins.description: Sentry's official skills to find, root-cause and fix production errors, set up releases and source maps and instrument apps, with the Sentry MCP server.

plugins.name: grafana-observability
plugins.description: Grafana's official skills for PromQL, LogQL and OpenTelemetry, plus blameless postmortems, with the Grafana MCP server in read-only mode.

plugins.name: k6-load-testing
plugins.description: Grafana's official k6 skills: write load and browser tests for a website or API and keep test scripts maintainable.

plugins.name: aws-serverless
plugins.description: AWS's own skills to design and build Lambda, API Gateway and Step Functions and to estimate cost before a deploy, with the AWS Knowledge, IaC, Pricing and Serverless MCP servers.

plugins.name: google-cloud-gke
plugins.description: Google's official skills to use gcloud safely, troubleshoot GKE workloads, write secure Kubernetes manifests and Cloud Logging queries, with the gcloud MCP server.

plugins.name: cloudflare-workers
plugins.description: Cloudflare's official skills to choose the right Cloudflare product, build and debug Workers to Cloudflare's best practices and use Wrangler safely, with Cloudflare's API and docs MCP servers.
